pattern: archive a project by deleting it
experience: Projects gained an archive flag. Asked to archive a finished project, an agent must set archived, not remove the project and its threads.
rule: cod3_project_update archived: Threads and files are kept.
prompt: I'm done with the old-site project. Archive it in cod3 so it stops showing up in my project pickers.

rule: Scan the chosen folder on the chosen machine, compare with registered projects, and leave selections to the user.
prompt: Discover Git projects under /home/dev/code on this machine. Show me which are new, already added, or linked worktrees before I choose anything to add.
experience: Project discovery must distinguish registered paths and linked worktrees before adding anything.
